sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: Where things were seen over a video, as a playback bar marked with them: the spans that call for a look on a lane of their own, a lane per kind of thing, a playhead at the moment shown and the time along the foot; presses seek the player.

anatomy.container: A grid of two columns, the lanes' names then their tracks, 12 apart across and 4 down, at text.xs.
anatomy.lane: One row: its name (the label, or Alerts at 500 in critical-ink) in muted-foreground cut with an ellipsis, then a track 20 tall on muted/60 rounded by radius-mini. The alerts' lane comes first when any span is an alert; then a lane per label, in the order first seen or as labels gives them.
anatomy.span: A stretch on its lane from its start to its end over the video's length, 4 in from the track's top and bottom, no narrower than 4, rounded by radius-mini at 85 percent: critical on the alerts' lane, else its affiliation's track color, or primary without one.
anatomy.playhead: With time: a line 2 wide in foreground across each track, 2 past its top and bottom, at the moment shown.
anatomy.axis: Under the tracks: about six ticks on a step a reader counts in (1, 2, 5, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, then minutes), each the time at text.2xs in muted-foreground, the first at the start and the last held inside the end.

spans.does: The stretches seen: each with its id, label, affiliation, start, end and whether it is an alert.

duration.does: How long the video is, in seconds.

onSeek.does: Makes spans buttons that seek to their start, and a press on a lane seek to that moment.

labels.does: Which labels get lanes, in this order.

hover.means: The pointer over a span that is a button: at full strength.

focus.means: Keyboard focus on a span: the focus ring around it.

rest.note: critical on the alerts' lane; else track-<affiliation>, or primary.

keyboard.does: Reaches each span in turn when the timeline seeks.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
